summary.headline: Enemies and Causes of Death
summary.text: Astrological rules for enemies: malefics in the twelfth house indicate the native’s advantage over enemies, while fortunes there indicate enemy prosperity and victory; the twelfth-house lord’s relation to the Sun, Moon, ascendant, and planetary qualities distinguishes vile from exalted enmity. Chapter 37 begins a discussion of the quality and occasions of death, using the ascendant, its lord, the part of death, the fourth sign, planetary aspects, triplicity lords, the seventh house, and the eighth signs from the Sun and Moon.
